title: Change-Day Rates for Late Changes to Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
**Rate card — Specimen Collection Appointments.** A late change to a home visit starts from a change-day rate. Count calendar days from today (the day the change is recorded) to the current appointment date on the visit record; the start time is the visit's current appointment start.

| Change recorded | Visit start | Change-day rate (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| On the appointment date itself (0 days) | Any | 55.00 |
| The day before (1 day) | Before 09:00 | 45.00 |
| The day before (1 day) | 09:00 or later | 40.00 (the published late-cancellation fee) |

**Clause.** Counting calendar days from today to the current appointment date, a change recorded on the appointment date itself starts from 55.00, a change recorded the day before a visit that starts before 09:00 starts from 45.00, and any other late change starts from the published late-cancellation fee of 40.00. The published late-cancellation fee is 40.00 for the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and 0.00 for the other visit types.

### Boundary readings (hypothetical visits)

- Visit starting 08:00, change recorded the day before: 45.00.
- Visit starting 09:00, change recorded the day before: 40.00 — 09:00 is not before 09:00.
- Visit starting 14:00, change recorded on the appointment date: 55.00.
